# One van, ten requests: which jobs should it run today?

> Paste the day's requested mobile tire and roadside jobs and get the most profitable set and order for one van, with time windows, drive cost and a price for every job it turns down. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/mobile-tire-van-job-picker/)
